title: Coordinate formula for a transpose
statement: For natural numbers n, m and continuous linear maps L : R^n -> R^m and T : R^m -> R^n (R^k = EuclideanSpace R (Fin k) = Rn k) such that <T w, v> = <w, L v> for all w in R^m and v in R^n: T w = sum_{i<n} <L e_i, w> e_i for every w in R^m, where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 is the i-th standard basis vector of R^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (L : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn m) (T : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn n), (∀ (w : Rn m) (v : Rn n), inner ℝ (T w) v = inner ℝ w (L v)) → ∀ w : Rn m, T w = ∑ i : Fin n, inner ℝ (L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) w • EuclideanSpace.single i 1
